Settings

Signed in as …

Business Details

Your registered business name — separate from the "Site name" under Branding, which is the storefront's public-facing name.

Identifies your account with SitePragati for renewal checks and maintenance requests. Only change this if SitePragati support asks you to.

Branding

Shown in place of the site name in the storefront header. Upload it anywhere you like (e.g. an image host, or a Google Drive "Share" link) and paste the URL here. Recommended: a transparent PNG or SVG, roughly 240×80px.

Contact Details

Shown to customers in the storefront footer — leave any of these blank to hide that line.

Shown as both a "Call us" and a "Chat on WhatsApp" link — one number covers both.

Payment (QR code)

Customers scan this at checkout instead of a card payment form.

Shipping Fee

Charged automatically at checkout, based on the customer's delivery state.

Admin Console Access

Control what your Admin Console staff logins can see and manage. Product configuration always stays available here in the Vendor Portal.

When off, Admin Console users won’t see the Products tab or be able to add, edit or delete products.
